name: Boros Legion
description: The Boros Legion is the military red-white guild of Ravnica, devoted to law and order, whose guildhall is Sunhome and whose guildmaster is Aurelia.

description_citations.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.
"The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

summary.text: The Boros Legion is the military red-white guild of Ravnica, devoted to law and order, whose guildhall is Sunhome and whose guildmaster is Aurelia.

citations.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.
"The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

bio.text: Its guildhall is Sunhome, and its guildmaster in various stories is Aurelia, though Feather's claim to lead it was disputed.

citations.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.
"The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.
"Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

bio.text: Boros minotaurs complained to Jace that the Orzhov had violated a boundary contract, and Jace ruled that they must file a proper complaint with Lavinia.

citations.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

bio.text: Gideon brought the captured Krenko to a Boros garrison.

citations.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Later, Boros officers were exposed to zombie fungus, and a lich told Boros soldiers that he had planted a mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her.

citations.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.
"Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion, Vraska had Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

bio.text: At Karlov Manor, Aurelia gathered the Legion and marched it to war.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

status.text: As of the latest story, the guild is led by Aurelia, and its guards protect a perimeter and post false necromancy notices.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Razia credits the Boros with turning a wild goblin into a focused soldier.
timeline.quote: The Boros have given him the skill of a soldier and focused his heart with a single cause.

citation.text: Boros Recruit (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yuri takes up the ragged Boros banner and inspires his brethren back into the fight.
timeline.quote: Yuri took up the ragged Boros banner, and his brethren, inspired by the act, followed him back into the fight.

citation.text: Rally the Righteous (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Brev Grezar admires a flame item as lantern and lance.
timeline.quote: Now *that's* military efficiency.

citation.text: Flame Fusillade (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The loxodon hierarch is willing to die to bring back the Ravnica of his memory.
timeline.quote: If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it.

citation.text: Loxodon Hierarch (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Boros Legion is founded by the archangel Razia.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion was founded by parun Razia

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boros Legion members are revealed to be Lupul and attack Fonn and her allies, who narrowly escape.
timeline.quote: Fonn and her allies narrowly escaped their attack

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Parhelion reappears on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
timeline.quote: The Dissension began with the dramatic reappearance of the Parhelion

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveys Sunhome from a rooftop and notes many dead soldiers loaded onto a Golgari corpse-hauler.
timeline.quote: Krenko began his surveillance on Sunhome, the imposing Boros guildhall.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: A fistfight breaks out among the soldiers, and Krenko enjoys the tension.
timeline.quote: Such undisciplined hot-headedness seemed very un-Boros.

citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros, arguing a disgraced angel cannot command respect.
timeline.quote: Feather was later replaced by one of these Angels, Aurelia

citation.text: "Angel", section "Firemane angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Razia's death, the Boros work as hired guards, mostly for Orzhov families, under guildmaster Feather.
timeline.quote: the Boros mainly worked as paid bodyguards and security officials for the highest bidders, mostly Orzhov families

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Discontented Boros gather under the war-leader Aurelia, who argues that no disgraced angel should lead them.
timeline.quote: gathered under the war-leader Aurelia, who argued that no disgraced angel should lead the Boros

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The Interregnum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica Gideon accepts command of Boros soldiers from Aurelia but refuses membership.
timeline.quote: accepted command of the soldiers, shirking her offer of membership

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orzhov thugs harass Busa in front of Boros patrolmen, raising the protection rate.
timeline.quote: Today they doubled the rate and said they'd cut my daughter's toes off if I didn't pay on time.

citation.text: "Rogue's Passage". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Nov 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gorev remembers the old Boros under Razia and the angels of Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Gorev was one of them, beholding his angelic commander, bathing in her fierce, sublime gaze.

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gorev tells Pel the Boros stood for 10,000 years of order on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: They stood for 10,000 years of order on Ravnica.

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Boros built a prison in the sky out of the reach of Azorius statutes.
timeline.quote: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

citation.text: Angelic Edict (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Boros troops lost the respect of the citizens after the battle for Barbu Rooftop.
timeline.quote: We lost respect after the battle for Barbu Rooftop.

citation.text: Knight Watch (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, ending the Warmind Initiative collaboration between Boros and Izzet.
timeline.quote: Before Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, the two guilds had collaborated on the Warmind Initiative

citation.text: Warmind Infantry (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Skyknights seized Millennium Platform for its strategic location.
timeline.quote: Millennium Platform, once a monument to peace, was quickly seized by the skyknights

citation.text: Skyknight Legionnaire (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins against Boros interference.
timeline.quote: Tired of Boros interference, the Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins

citation.text: Wojek Halberdiers (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Boros are losing their angels to the Gateless Movement.
timeline.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

citation.text: Urbis Protector (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon is escorted into the Boros war room and feels Aurelia's overwhelming angelic aura.
timeline.quote: her aura was an order of magnitude higher than any he had encountered

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia recounts that after the Guildpact broke the Azorius abandoned the Ninth and it was largely lost, under a disgraced earlier Boros leader.
timeline.quote: in the aftermath, the Azorius had to abandon the Ninth so they could rebuild New Prahv.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia reveals the Boros were once led by a disgrace to the Legion, which forced a change in guild leadership.
timeline.quote: We were led by a disgrace to the Legion.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia takes Gideon to a balcony overlooking Boros armies training and says she wishes to cleanse the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Ninth is a stain on Ravnica, a stain on the Boros, and a stain on my soul.

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads a horde of Gruul into the square, where the Boros fire down on them from rooftops.
timeline.quote: From the rooftops and upper floors, a blaze of Boros magic lit the square with streams of fire that slammed into the Gruul.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Boros charge the Gruul hand to hand.
timeline.quote: Gideon and the Boros rushed from their positions to engage the Gruul hand-to-hand.

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives late at the Chamber of the Guildpact to find Boros minotaurs complaining that the Orzhov have violated a boundary contract.
timeline.quote: The Orzhov violated our boundary contract!

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace rules that the minotaurs must file a proper complaint with Lavinia, and the lead minotaur sheathes his axe.
timeline.quote: You will file a proper complaint with Deputy Lavinia

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Back at the Chamber, Lavinia reports the guilds now know of Vraska, and Jace, uneasy about Garruk, prepares to leave for a few days.
timeline.quote: And I think something's up with Garruk.

citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Gideon cleanses the Ninth District, after which none of the ganglords challenge the Boros.
timeline.quote: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

citation.text: Unquestioned Authority (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ral and Jace watch from a Boros garrison for a Planeswalker Ral has been tracking, who does not appear.
timeline.quote: It's a Planeswalker I've been tracking.

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
timeline.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Alovnek declares he will have justice now rather than await the arbiters.
timeline.quote: But I will have justice now.

citation.text: Condemn (Commander 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia urges troops to fight for Sunhome with the truth in their hearts.
timeline.quote: You'll fight for Sunhome with the truth in your heart.

citation.text: Gird for Battle (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Several angels leave the Boros after Aurelia's assaults to protect the guildless.
timeline.quote: several angels left the Boros and dedicated themselves to the protection of the guildless

citation.text: "Angel", section "Unguilded angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros.
timeline.quote: Aurelia ascended to the leadership of the Boros

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Replacing Feather". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia becomes guildmaster and reforms the guild, encouraging angels to mingle with lower ranks.
timeline.quote: After Aurelia assumed the office of guildmaster, she established several changes to the way the guild was run.

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
timeline.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guild is reorganized into small local garrisons so spies can compromise only one.
timeline.quote: the reorganization of the guild into countless small local forces

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "Further decentralization". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko accepts a job from Mr. Taz to raid the Boros guildhall and is given a glowing shiv.
timeline.quote: Mr. Taz gave Krenko a tool specially made for that job.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Krenko surveils Sunhome, pushes it into violence and uses the chaos to reach Vinrenn's chambers.
timeline.quote: He provided that push and used the ensuing chaos to cover his actions

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sergeant Skormak promotes Ossett to Wojek, giving her a red cord and a sealed letter.
timeline.quote: My first accolade.

citation.text: "Clans & Legions" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
timeline.quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
timeline.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich reveals he hopes Boros will back a Devkarin successor as guildmaster, and the soldiers hint Zegodonis is their pick.
timeline.quote: they take into consideration the help I've been to you today.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Angels bring the dawn over the citadel.
timeline.quote: Then the angels brought the dawn.

citation.text: Finale of Glory (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia and the Boros fight in the vanguard against Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: Aurelia and the Boros Legion were in the vanguard of the troops fighting Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cult fights in Ravnica's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion, then fills the aftermath with entertainments, increasingly clashing with the Boros.
timeline.quote: The Cult fought just as hard as anyone else in Ravnica's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
timeline.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: As frontline fighters against the New Phyrexian Invasion the Boros suffer heavy losses and a crisis of faith; Aurelia takes the losses hard.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Aurelia took the losses particularly hard.

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azorius senators set up verity circles to question all guests.
timeline.quote: They had cast their spells with admirable speed

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Etrata evades the Boros and Azorius but not Kaya.
timeline.quote: Etrata evaded the Boros arresters and Azorius lawmages, but not even a master assassin could give Kaya the slip.

citation.text: The Chase Is On (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After an attempt on her life, Aurelia gives the Agency a day to solve the case or the Boros will declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.
timeline.quote: solve the case in twenty-four hours, or the Boros Legion would declare war on the Cult of Rakdos.

citation.text: Demand Answers (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia musters the Boros Legion as Kaya and Kellan race to prevent a guild war.
timeline.quote: While Aurelia mustered the Boros Legion, Kaya and Kellan raced against the clock, desperate to stave off a war the guilds might not survive.

citation.text: Warleader's Call (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Promoted to Wojek, Ossett becomes a Boros counterintelligence agent.
timeline.quote: After she was promoted to Wojek , Ossett Weslyn found herself at the forefront of Boros counterintelligence efforts.

citation.text: "Ossett Weslyn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wyroon is ousted from the Boros Legion years ago for insubordination.
timeline.quote: who was ousted from the Boros Legion years ago for insubordination

citation.text: "Precinct Six", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the Agency grows to the size of the ten guilds and becomes pivotal in restoring peace on the plane.
timeline.quote: The Agency was pivotal in restoring the peace on the plane

citation.text: "Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boros notices warn of necromantic energy that is not actually present.
timeline.quote: you see Boros notices, warning of necromantic energy in the area, but you don't detect anything.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In one path, the reader launches pigeons from a trebuchet to distract the guards.
timeline.quote: you purchase a cage of pigeons from a passing vendor and rig a rudimentary trebuchet

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Several approaches to the guards end with the reader taken into Boros custody.
timeline.quote: You are taken off to spend the day in Boros custody.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The reader bluffs past guards by pretending to deliver flowers for the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Delivery for the Guildpact.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Razia flies the Parhelion through the Schism to fight Szadek; Razia is killed with countless Boros angels.
timeline.quote: Razia was killed, along with countless Boros angels

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thirty years before the War of the Spark, Aresaan's catastrophic decision kills fifteen thousand Boros soldiers and she is stripped of her wings.
timeline.quote: resulted in the deaths of fifteen thousand Boros soldiers

citation.text: "Aresaan", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ossett Weslyn arranges Baas's release to gain information about a spy within the Boros Legion.
timeline.quote: Ossett arranged for Baas' release to gain crucial information about a spy within the Boros Legion.

citation.text: "Baas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Boros plan to lure Gruul and Rakdos forces together so they kill each other; Gideon and Anza lure the Gruul while Tajic lures the Rakdos.
timeline.quote: the Boros tried to lure Gruul and Rakdos forces together in order to make them kill each other

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dars assembles the Firefist hidden in the square on Gideon's orders and waits.
timeline.quote: On Gideon's orders, Dars had assembled the Firefist in the square, hidden in the surrounding buildings.

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Firefist disengages and forms a wall as the Rakdos pour in and tear into the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Dars ordered a knight to sound the trumpet

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros close in, a success.
timeline.quote: Rakdos and Gruul slaughtered each other in the center of the square

citation.text: "Dars Gostok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the guilds struggle with their duties, independent detective agencies gain prominence and the guilds grudgingly accept their help.
timeline.quote: they were forced to grudgingly accept assistance

citation.text: "Detective", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feather submits for arrest during the Dissension, revealing she is the last surviving Boros angel; later she is named Boros Guildmaster.
timeline.quote: she was named as the Boros Guildmaster

citation.text: "Feather", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boros Firemanes lead a victorious assault on the rebels; the Gateless mark their leader Nevena for death.
timeline.quote: Boros Firemanes led a victorious assault on the rebels.

citation.text: "Guildless", section "The Gateless Movement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angels build the Parhelion as a skyship to seek the vanished planeswalkers and fly it to the edge of Ravnica's existence.
timeline.quote: they encountered only emptiness

citation.text: "Parhelion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Parhelion II is steered to the Tenth District plaza in the War of the Spark and used to launch skyknights and angels against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: used as a base for launching skyknights and angels against the Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Parhelion", section "Parhelion II". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion's headquarters, starting a war; Dimir Lupul worms attack.
timeline.quote: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion ’s headquarters, and it's war.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruric Thar, named the Gruul's maze-runner, is helped by Squelch against Boros guards.
timeline.quote: was helped out by the Izzet goblin named Squelch in return for chickens

citation.text: "Ruric Thar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek is sent to Parhelion to kill the Boros angels and Razia.
timeline.quote: He then sent Szadek to Parhelion to kill the Boros angels
